notes.title: Developer Update April
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/12ed1b20a00e00a6b4157d9cc9e5afdf5fe729c9.png[/img]

Greeting fellow tinkerers, 

It’s been a few moons since the last update, and we are now back to share some more information about what we have been up to! Last year, we talked about a major project that we started working on with a new database rework that is going to help us with performance and much more. Work is moving forward and will soon be ready to be released with a major update, but let’s jump in and look at the progress and what you will get your hands on soon.   


[b]New biome, monsters, and dungeon! [/b]

Since last time, the team has been focused on the lava biome, adding several points of interest, new enemies, and finalizing a new dungeon for you to explore. The lava biome can get extremely hot, so make sure you're wearing the proper equipment before venturing inside.  


Just like our other dungeons, you'll need to find the missing pieces to unlock the entrance to the boss. But be warned, the road is treacherous and filled with traps. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/rsT7vJbq/2.gif[/img]

[b]New things to catch and craft! [/b]

Some fishes have already adapted to the new biome. So, in the upcoming update, we will introduce several new species. With the right gear, bait and strategy, you might be able to catch what's swimming beneath the fiery lava rivers - just be careful! 

But wait, that's not all! We are also adding a bunch of new furniture pieces, walls, and flooring to the game. NPCs will also be getting new and unique pieces of furniture to decorate their homes and additional rewards. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGKH87Cb/1.gif[/img]

[b]Database Rework [/b]

We have been working on reworking our database to improve its stability and performance. Currently, save files consist of more than 10,000 individual files, which can negatively affect performance, particularly on slow hard drives. As a result, the game will now run smoother overall. The new save game is an SQLite file, which will enable us to introduce more complex changes in the future without compromising existing player saves. Additionally, this will allow very invested players to modify save games to match their preferences. However, we want to make it clear that this is NOT mod support. 

We do not want to give away too much, so there are plenty of surprises waiting for you in the upcoming update. We are currently putting the final touches on it, as well as preparing something exciting. Keep an eye on our social media or join our [url=https://discord.gg/sU46TSjMdP]Discord community[/url] to stay updated! 
 
The Tinkertown Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.8 and the way forward! 🛣️
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/81c4cf23e2fa7a691da15b6f718f3842f5a2d01b.png[/img]

Dear Tinkerers,

It's been a few weeks since our latest dev blog, and we wanted to give you an update on where we are currently at. We’ve been working hard to optimize the overall experience of Tinkertown, especially from a technical perspective, and we will continue to do so for some time.

This means that our programmers are putting almost all their time into transforming the game backend towards a database structure, and optimizing the performance. Still, we're taking what time we have left to improve other features in the meantime.😊

[b]Therefore we’re now releasing patch 1.0.8.![/b]

Looking at your feedback on Steam and Discord, you mentioned that new quests and follow-up quests were hard to spot. In 1.0.8, we’ve added an indicator on each NPC to show whether there’s a new quest, and updated the icons within the quest UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/b6691fdaba034dfa762160ffbb01f830c7935d0b.png[/img]

One of the other bigger requests from you was some sort of guidance system that helps players through quests. A way of making it easier to find the right places, monsters and required materials and items.
Unfortunately, the current Tinkertown backend does not support such a system, but the new database structure in development will let us add it. This support feature will be implemented from the start when we release the new backend in the future!

[b]What’s next for Tinkertown?[/b]

The 1.1 update will include the promised NPC Rewards, from decoratives to friendly critters, monsters and whatever more we can cook up until then!

We also have a certain creepy holiday coming up soon, maybe that will be reflected in Tinkertown…

That brings us to the last, and most important bit: [b]your feedback![/b]

We’d love to focus our work on the issues you feel need to be tackled the most, please let us know your thoughts [url=https://forms.office.com/e/02JjAgw2bq]in this feedback form[/url]. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we will make sure to follow up on the results of the form in a future Steam post.

Thanks for your continued engagement!

Your Tinkertown team

notes.title: Lunar New Year & Building Update!
notes.notes:
Lovely Tinkerers,

The new year has just begun and we’re kicking it off, celebrating the Lunar New Year, as well as the Base Builder Fest! And that means there’s some new stuff for you to find during the fest, as well as some additions that have the power to change your Tinkertown worlds forever!
Our latest content drop adds new alternate weapons as well as decorations and a costume to celebrate the year of the Water Rabbit for a few weeks. You will also be able to find last years items, too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/6ae3bf403804ad27461c119211228b49746f2823.gif[/img]

As for the builder aspect of Tinkertown: We’ve added new shovels that will allow the player to not just remove gras or sand, but also the dirt underneath! And what’s underneath the dirt? Yes, WATER! In return, you will also be able to place any dirt on water, terraforming your Tinkertown world! Create islands, ponds or a moat, let your imagination run wild!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/81b0f49358a3c7ded2b108c071c9210457d777e0.gif[/img]


To give you a better idea of what we’ve added, here’s a short list:

[list]
[*] 1 new costume set
[*] 3 new weapon skin variants
[*] 2 new placeables to celebrate the year of the water rabbit
[*] 2 new shovel tiers to remove different material tiers of ground layers
[*] 2 new placeable ground types to create a foundation on Water.
[*] 2 new floor types
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the update and don't forget to share your creations with us via forum or join our Discord! We are so excited to see what you build with the new content!

Happy Lunar New Year,

your Tinkertown Team

notes.title: The "Travel Update" brings Mine Carts and Fast Travel Stations to Tinkertown!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/0f622e64c3a1d81f3b8d27f27eb6a39f8652f9e7.jpg[/img]

Dear Tinkerers,

forget about endlessly walking back and forth between dungeons, houses, outposts, and whatever places you’d like to visit regularly within your world. With the latest update we’re introducing new ways to travel!

[b]Our "Travel Update" comes with two new transportation systems:[/b]

[u][b]Mine Carts on Rails[/b][/u]
You can connect several locations with the various types of rails and then hop into a Mountable Mine Cart to travel faster than ever before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/53081d3b8459b43ec0cad5c9313ed8291e252e32.gif[/img]

[u][b]The Fast Travel Station[/b][/u]
If mine carts aren't really your style though, you can cross huge distances in an instant with the Fast Travel Stations. Fast Travel Stations are teleporters you can place all over the map and travel directly between those stations. You enter one, choose another station as your desired destination and the teleporter takes you there. Easy!

The Travel Update also includes a few improvements upon the new mechanics we introduced in the recent "Combat & Classes" Update, like charge-attacks, weapon scaling and new stats. But we are just getting started. [b]Tinkertown[/b] will continue to grow with more updates planned!

[b]The new Travel Update contains:[/b]
[list][*] 5 Railway types to build and customize your own tracks
[*] A Mountable Mine Cart to travel the rails
[*] A Fast Travel Station

Greetings Tinkerers!

The new Forest Dungeon is here and we’re celebrating the occasion with a [b]30% discount[/b]!

We had a blast opening the Desert Dungeon a while ago and promised to give each Biome the same love, which means each of them each need to get a great Dungeon. With that in mind, it was just fair to get back to the Forest and rework what’s hidden underneath this enormous Skull-Entrance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/9f702197960325c64c2a0c4da81be825fca9d9ef.jpg[/img]

At the same time, the refreshed Forest Dungeon Update will lead [b]Tinkertown[/b] into a new experience [b]if[/b] players wish to do so: [b]Progression![/b]

[i][b]Let’s have a quick look at all the goods that Patch 0.8.1 will introduce:[/b][/i] 
[list][*] An overhauled Dungeon and a new Boss to challenge! (We will miss you Golem!)
[*] 3 new and dangerous enemy types
[*] A new optional Progression System to guide fresh and seasoned players alike through the world of Tinkertown
[*] A World Map with Location Icons of each Dungeon accessible by using the craftable Globe. (You still have to get there yourself, though!)
[*] New Weapons (including a reworked Boomerang), Armor Pieces and Magic Wands!
[*] Additional bonus movement speed on player crafted Floors! 
[*] A new dish and a super cute decoration to brighten up your room: Baby Oakling[/list]

[i][b]Now… What is this “progression”?[/b][/i]
Since Tinkertown’s first launch, we sensed at some point it would be awesome to introduce a mode besides the Open world one, raising the challenge for exploration, while simultaneously introducing a common thread that loosely guides the player through the biomes.

It’s called “Adventure Mode” paves the way to a deeper lore of Tinkertown, yet to be discovered!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/2b4ca2036ee3556281f6589dca949a68ca6b876b.jpg[/img]

[i][b]And what’s next?[/b][/i]
Of course we are aware that there are three biomes but just TWO Dungeons! And the Progression System is not fully implemented into the other biomes yet, therefore watch out for our next big update:

[b]The ICE Dungeon![/b]

And now without further ado, enjoy the new Update and happy dungeoneering!

notes.title: Multiplayer Update is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/5f5d171eefce2a42a73bdd97c624f8d216eccdf6.jpg[/img]

Greetings Tinkerers!

As you may know (from your own experience), we had to deal with multiplayer connection issues between players since the early access release of [b]Tinkertown[/b]. It was an urgent issue that prevented many players from enjoying [b]Tinkertown[/b] together with their friends and family.

Since then, we worked constantly to find the root of the issue, gathered your bug reports and tried to deliver workarounds to the best of our abilities and still develop new content simultaneously. Some of the workarounds and the UPnPsupport patch helped some of the players, but not everyone.

[b]But today is the day we can finally announce the release of our major Multiplayer Update![/b]

We put a lot of work into the update and reworked the multiplayer of [b]Tinkertown[/b] significantly.

For example, [b]Tinkertown[/b] now uses the “PlayFab Party” service for online multiplayer. We updated the network code, fixed issues where players could not connect to each other, allow players to play offline, and [b]even solved some issues where some players were not able to start a single player game![/b]

[b]The update should finally be the solution for all players to connect to each other reliably and without any issues.[/b] And we hope that you’re all able enjoy the improved multiplayer experience!

This update is a big leap for us, and we are already on track for the [b]next major content update[/b].

[b]Early Access 0.5.0 Patch Notes:[/b]
[list][*] Multiplayer now uses "PlayFab Party" service
[*] Fixed plenty of issues where players could not connect to each other
[*] Implemented cloud-based relay servers, allowing players with strict NAT types to connect
[*] Improved NAT punchthrough
[*] Improved data encryption between server and client endpoints
[*] Updated network code
[*] Fixed an issue where players could not play single player while offline
[*] Fixed an issue where maps could not be deleted from within the ingame menu
[*] Players can now save multiple maps with the same seed
[*] Improved server performance and memory usage
[*] Updated intro splash screen[/list]
So stay tuned for more information and teasers about the next update.
We would love to get your feedback!
